site.name: Kausar Patherya
site.headline: I want intelligent agents, biological and artificial, that navigate efficiently across modalities to achieve their goals
site.bio: ... you can't always get what you want. But if you try sometime, you might get what you need. In my case, that's a CS PhD at Georgia Tech, where I build interactive AI systems that are useful, reliable, and inexpensive. See what I did there? 😉 My writings come straight from the heart (and mind), and I want to take you along on my journey. Any project code I release prioritizes reusability and extensibility. If you find my code and writing useful, we should talk. I'd love to learn from you.
